census.labels: THEORETICAL. No order existed, nothing was submitted, filled, settled or realized, and our own size would have changed the book it is measured against.
caveats: OUR OWN SIZE WOULD HAVE CHANGED THE BOOK. Improving the touch puts us in front of everyone; the prints that then arrive are not the prints that arrived without us.
QUEUE IS READABLE ON THE YES SIDE ONLY. The venue publishes one ladder, so NO-leg overlays get a reaching-print count and no queue-respecting answer.
A REACHING PRINT IS NOT A FILL. It is an execution that crossed our hypothetical price; whether it would have reached us depends on the queue, and on our order having been there at all.
IMPROVE_1_TICK IS REFUSED WHEREVER IT WOULD NOT BE MAKER-ONLY, so its sample is smaller than the others by construction and the two are not compared over the same cycles unless stated.
